_comment: Pinned container images. Every tag AND digest here was resolved against the live registry (Docker Hub / quay.io) rather than written from memory. Compose pins by digest, so a retagged upstream image cannot silently change a developer's stack.
_upgrade_procedure: 1. Resolve the new tag and its digest from the registry.
2. Update both fields here in one commit, with the reason.
3. Run `python scripts/dev.py check M00 --suite standalone` against the new images.

postgres.why: PostgreSQL is required: the platform depends on JSONB, uuid and transactional DDL. 17.x is the current stable line; 18.x exists but is newer than the rest of this stack has been verified against.

redis.why: Celery broker. Started ONLY for modules that declare broker or worker.

python.why: Matches the interpreter the backend lockfiles were compiled for (--python-version 3.12), so a container install resolves the same wheels as local.

node.why: Vite dev server and the frontend test runner. Note the host may have an older Node; the container version is authoritative for CI and Compose.

minio.why: S3-compatible private object storage for local development. Published on quay.io, not Docker Hub. Started ONLY for modules that declare object_storage.
